reason: The cited evidence (E1) shows a single-phase BCC structure and good 1000 °C strength in NbMoTa, but it does not address density reduction, partial Ta substitution by Nb, or the effect of such substitution on room-temperature or high-temperature mechanical properties relative to HfMoTaTiZr. The key premises thus lack specific prior support.

Single-phase BCC structure can be retained after partial Ta→Nb substitution
